title: Understanding LLM Parameter Update Sparsity through the Lens of Fisher
abstract: arXiv:2609.36262v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent studies have observed that parameter changes during language-model post-training can be concentrated in a small subset of coordinates. This phenomenon has been reported in reinforcement learning, on-policy distillation, and supervised fine-tuning on near-policy data. Its recurrence across different post-training paradigms suggests shared structure in training dynamics. In this paper, we examine this pattern through the diagonal model Fisher, which measures the sensitivity of the model's output distribution to individual parameters and is independent of any particular reward or teacher signal. Theoretically, we show that small diagonal Fisher leads to small expected gradients across a range of training objectives, providing a common explanation for sparse gradient updates. translated_title: 通过Fisher信息视角理解大语言模型参数更新稀疏性
translated_abstract: 近期研究观察到，语言模型在后训练过程中的参数变化往往集中在少数参数坐标的子集上。这一现象已在强化学习、在线策略蒸馏以及基于近策略数据的监督微调中被报道。该现象在不同后训练范式中的反复出现，暗示训练动态中存在共同的结构。本文通过对角模型Fisher信息来考察这一模式，该信息度量了模型输出分布对单个参数的敏感性，且不依赖于任何特定的奖励或教师信号。理论上，我们证明了较小的对角Fisher信息会在一系列训练目标下带来较小的期望梯度，从而为稀疏梯度更新提供了一个统一的解释。实证方面，我们在强化学习（RL）和在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中验证了这一联系。我们发现Fisher信息能够识别梯度集中的位置，并且从初始模型中选取的固定稀疏掩码……
tldr: 本文通过对角Fisher信息从理论与实证两方面揭示了大语言模型后训练中参数更新稀疏化的成因，证明Fisher信息小的参数对应较小的期望梯度，为稀疏梯度更新提供了不依赖奖励或教师信号的统一解释。
en_tdlr: This paper explains the sparsity of parameter updates during LLM post-training through the diagonal Fisher information, showing theoretically that parameters with small Fisher yield small expected gradients across training objectives, thus providing a unified, reward- and teacher-independent explanation for sparse gradient updates.
